 Space Exploration Technologies Plans $40 Billion GPU Equipment Lease
 Less than 1 min read SPCX Space Exploration Technologies entered a binding commitment to pursue a GPU equipment lease with expected principal payments of approximately $40 billion. 
 Key Highlights: 
 An entity managed by Apollo Global Management is expected to acquire and lease GPU pods and related equipment for the company’s selected data centers. 
 The contemplated lease schedules would run about five to five-and-a-quarter years, with quarterly rent paid in advance. 
 The master lease is subject to closing conditions and is expected to close before year-end; schedules are expected to commence in the first half of 2027 as GPUs are delivered. 
 Original SEC Filing: SPACE EXPLORATION TECHNOLOGIES CORP [ SPCX ] - 8-K - Oct. 26, 2026
